text: How many of Lebanon's dead were fighters? Lebanon's health ministry counts 4,386 dead since 2 March, with no combatant split. Israel puts Hezbollah dead at roughly 1,700-2,500. Hezbollah publishes no totals. No figure reconciles the three.

judge.comment: Both sides attributed with tracker figures; the health-ministry as-of date is not stated beyond 'cumulative since 2 March', so a human should confirm before publishing.

factChecks.claim: Lebanese Ministry of Public Health: 4,386 killed, cumulative since 2 March, no civilian/combatant split

text: How much Russian refining capacity is actually down? Ukraine's General Staff said 42.74% in July. The IEA said losses were "more than 20%" at peak. Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%, as undamaged refineries offset losses.

judge.comment: Three attributed figures from the tracker's unresolved-dispute record, no adjudication.

factChecks.claim: Ukraine's General Staff put disabled capacity at 42.74% in July 2026
IEA said losses were 'more than 20%' at peak
Reuters reported national oil processing fell only 3-6%

text: Iran claims a supertanker carrying 2M barrels of oil sank after hitting a mine in Hormuz. Not independently verified. It follows Nov 13 explosions on four tankers and Iran's Nov 14 report of three more on fire.

judge.comment: Claim is attributed to Iran and flagged as unverified; consistent with tracker events. Time-sensitive.

factChecks.claim: Iran claims supertanker with 2 million barrels sank after hitting a mine in Hormuz
Iran's navy reported three tankers on fire after mines on Nov 14

text: Ukraine reportedly hit the Kerch (Crimean) bridge and launched its largest drone attack on Russia of the war, including Moscow. Reported Nov 16; damage and casualty details are not yet confirmed.

judge.comment: Wording preserves 'reportedly' and states details are unconfirmed; matches tracker digest and event.

factChecks.claim: Largest drone attack on Russia since the war began, including Moscow

text: ECDC, as of Nov 8: 10,920 confirmed Ebola cases and 5,323 related deaths in the DRC. Kenya discharged its last patient Nov 11, but Africa CDC warns the outbreak is far from over.

judge.comment: Figures are sourced to ECDC with an as-of date and match tracker KPIs and events.
